description: This file contains configuration code and setup functions for Honda Accord and related Honda vehicles, including ECU parameter definitions, sensor setup, output pin configuration, and vehicle-specific settings for engine management.

methods.name: setHondaAccordConfigurationCommon
methods.description: Configures common engine parameters for Honda Accord based on the specific vehicle configuration, including sensors, injection, ignition, and output pin setup.

methods.name: setHondaAccordConfigurationThreeWires
methods.description: Sets engine configuration for Honda Accord with a three-wire trigger setup, calling the common configuration setup internally.

methods.name: setHondaAccordConfigurationDip
methods.description: Sets engine configuration for Honda Accord Dip trigger type.

methods.name: setHondaAccordConfiguration1_24
methods.description: Configures Honda Accord with 1-24 trigger type.

methods.name: setHondaAccordConfiguration1_24_shifted
methods.description: Configures Honda Accord with shifted 1-24 trigger setup, including setting trigger offset.

methods.name: setHondaCivic4_0_both
methods.description: Configures a 4-tooth toothed wheel with both edges triggering for civic, based on shifted 1-24 setup.

methods.name: setHondaCivic4_0_rise
methods.description: Configures a 4-tooth toothed wheel with rising edges only for civic, based on shifted 1-24 setup.
